name: Kinetic Sniper
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kinetic blast class feature, extended range infusion, Precise Shot.

Benefit(s): Your extended range form infusion doesn’t count against the normal limit of 1 form infusion per kinetic blast. It does not affect blasts used as part of an attack, charge, or full-attack action or any blast with a cone, line, or emanation area of effect.

Normal: You can only apply 1 form infusion to a blast.
